form.label: Data Replay
form.description: Replay Ingest Actions output (file system / S3) for a sourcetype and time range. Events keep their original index, host, source and sourcetype, and get the indexed field replay_job=<job id>.

search.query: | inputlookup replay_catalog | stats sum(files) AS files min(day) AS first max(day) AS last by sourcetype | eval label=sourcetype." (".first." .. ".last.")" | sort 0 sourcetype

panel.title: Replay jobs (click a row to verify what was indexed)

search.query: | inputlookup replay_jobs | eval range=strftime(earliest, "%F %T")." → ".strftime(latest, "%F %T") | eval submitted=strftime(submitted_at, "%F %T"), completed=strftime(completed_at, "%F %T") | eval progress=if(files_total>0, files_done."/".files_total, "") | eval read_mb=round(bytes_read/1024/1024, 1) | sort 0 - submitted_at | head 200 | table job_id status sourcetype index_filter range progress read_mb events_staged events_indexed events_skipped events_bad submitted_by submitted completed agent_host message earliest latest

panel.title: Available data (per sourcetype and UTC day)

search.query: | inputlookup replay_catalog | eval size_mb=round(bytes/1024/1024, 1) | eval first_hour=strftime(earliest, "%F %H:%M"), last_hour=strftime(latest, "%F %H:%M") | eval catalog_age=tostring(now()-updated_at, "duration") | sort 0 sourcetype - day | table sourcetype day files size_mb first_hour last_hour backend catalog_age
